title: Adobe security advisory (AV26-1039)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1039 Date: October 14, 2026 As of October 13, 2026, Adobe is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Adobe Bridge Prior to or equal to 16.0.7 Adobe Bridge (LTS) Prior to or equal to 15.1.8 Adobe ColdFusion 2025 Version 2025.0.13 Adobe ColdFusion 2023 Version 2023.0.25 Adobe Commerce Multiple versions Adobe Commerce B2B Multiple versions Adobe Credentials SDK Multiple versions Adobe Dimension Prior to or equal to 4.1.8 Adobe Experience Manager Multiple versions Adobe FrameMaker 2022 Prior to or equal to 17.0.9.866 Adobe FrameMaker 2026 Prior to or equal to 18.0.0.206 Adobe Photoshop 2026 Prior to or equal to 27.10 Adobe Photoshop 2025 Prior to or equal to 26.11.7 Adobe Substance 3D Designer Prior to or equal to 16.05 Adobe Substance 3D Sampler Prior to or equal to 6.0.3 Adobe Substance 3D Stager Prior to or equal to 3.1.8 Magento Open Source Multiple versions The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Adobe Security Bulletins and Advisories (en anglais seulement) Article Link: Adobe security advisory (AV26-1039) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
